components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Claymorphic green gradient button. The primary CTA for all farmer-facing actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #06c755, #00a854); color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; padding: 12px 24px; min-height: 48px; border: none; border-radius: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 4px 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.15), -2px -2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.7), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5); cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 6px 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.18), -3px -3px 8px rgba(255,255,255,0.7), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: 2px 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neumorphic raised button for secondary actions. Subtle depth without competing with primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #171c1f; font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; padding: 12px 24px; min-height: 44px; border: none; border-radius: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 5px 5px 15px #d1d9e6, -5px -5px 15px #ffffff; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { box-shadow: 6px 6px 18px #c8d0da, -6px -6px 18px #ffffff; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent button for tertiary actions. Minimal visual weight.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #3c4a3c; font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; padding: 8px 16px; min-height: 44px; border: none; border-radius: 1.5rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f0f4f8; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Neumorphic inset input field. The data entry trough.
components.css: .ds-input-group { width: 100%; } .ds-input-label { display: block; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #3c4a3c; margin-bottom: 4px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; min-height: 44px; background: #f0f4f8; border: none; border-radius: 1.5rem; box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 8px #d1d9e6, inset -4px -4px 8px #ffffff; font-size: 16px; color: #171c1f; outline: none; transition: all 200ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6c7b6b; } .ds-input:focus { box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 8px #d1d9e6, inset -4px -4px 8px #ffffff, 0 0 0 2px #06c755; } .ds-input-error { box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 8px #d1d9e6, inset -4px -4px 8px #ffffff, 0 0 0 2px #ba1a1a; }

narrative.overview:
NetZeroCarbon bridges two worlds: the ancient rhythms of Thai rice farming and the precision of carbon credit verification. The design system must feel simultaneously organic and mathematically precise — a living tool that earns trust through openness, not promises.

The visual language is a deliberate hybrid of three depth systems. Claymorphism gives primary actions a tactile, squishy warmth. Neumorphism provides structural depth for data containers and input fields. Glassmorphism floats premium overlays and navigation above the content.

The system is bilingual (Thai primary, English secondary) and optimized for extreme conditions: bright outdoor sun, one-handed mobile use, elderly users, and intermittent connectivity.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile and organic — depth effects create physical presence; UI elements feel touchable
Evidence-first — every visual decision serves the verification chain
Bilingual-ready — Inter for Latin, Sarabun for Thai
Field-tough — 44px touch targets, high-contrast text, generous spacing
Three-audience calibration — farmer warmth, admin authority, sponsor confidence

rules.name: The LINE Green Rule
rules.body: LINE Green (#06c755) is the signature accent. It appears on primary CTAs, verified badges, and active nav icons — never on backgrounds, body text, or decorative fills. Its scarcity is the point.

rules.name: The Cloud Gray Foundation Rule
rules.body: The background is always Cloud Gray (#f0f4f8). Never Sky Blue, never white. The entire neumorphic shadow system assumes this exact base.

rules.name: The Dark Navy Isolation Rule
rules.body: Dark Navy (#1a1a2e) is used exclusively for the dashboard sidebar and nowhere else.

rules.name: The 1.6 Rule
rules.body: All body text uses 1.6 line-height. Thai script with combining vowels and tone marks requires the extra vertical space. Never reduce below 1.5.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: The system uses one type family (Inter/Sarabun) across all roles. No display fonts, no monospace, no accent typefaces.

rules.name: The Thumb Zone Rule
rules.body: On mobile, primary actions sit within the bottom 200px of the viewport — the natural thumb reach.

rules.name: The 288px Sidebar Rule
rules.body: Desktop dashboards always show the 288px sidebar. It is fixed-position, never collapsible.

rules.name: The Ground Rule
rules.body: The background is always Cloud Gray (#f0f4f8). The neumorphic shadow pair assumes this exact base.

rules.name: The Layer Integrity Rule
rules.body: Each depth layer has a purpose: structure (neumorphic), action (claymorphic), overlay (glassmorphic). Never mix.

rules.name: The No Sharp Corners Rule
rules.body: Every interactive element in farmer-facing surfaces uses at least 8px radius. Exceptions: sidebar and header.

rules.name: The Pill Badge Rule
rules.body: Status badges and chips are always pill-shaped (full radius). Their elongated form signals 'label' rather than 'button'.

dos: Use the claymorphic, neumorphic, neumorphic-inset, and glass utility classes for depth effects
Maintain 44px minimum touch targets on all interactive elements
Use LINE Green (#06c755) only on primary CTAs and verified indicators
Pair Inter with Sarabun for any text containing Thai characters
Use the Material Symbols Outlined icon font
Use Cloud Gray (#f0f4f8) as the background
donts: Don't use sharp corners on any farmer-facing element
Don't place Dark Navy outside the dashboard sidebar
Don't use ml-72 or left-72 Tailwind classes for sidebar offset
Don't load fonts via next/font/google — it breaks the static export
Don't apply glassmorphic treatment to cards or buttons
Don't use Berry Red for anything other than errors and rejected states
Don't reduce line-height below 1.5 for Thai text
